The '''haunting ghosts''' are [[monster]]s fought during the [[Zemouregal & Vorkath]] battle in the [[Zemouregal & Vorkath#Siege phase|siege phase]].

Two of them guard the northern [[place of power]]. While normally unaggressive, they attack the player when the [[Undead giant (Battle of Forinthry)|undead giant]] at the place of power is engaged and the player is in their range.
